fairness_rules: Retrieve exactly once per query and reuse the identical EvidencePacket across all architectures.
Inject the same LLMAdapter instance and fixed model/version into all architectures.
Initialize the same total token budget for each architecture-query cell.
Keep evidence-paper budget fixed across architectures.
Do not silently retry only one architecture.
Record provider-reported token usage when a real adapter is connected.
Architecture-specific coordination may change the number of calls; total token ceiling remains matched and call count is an outcome.
reproducibility_notes: Model identifier frozen to gpt-6.1-sol for Means Restriction Pilot v1.
Use OpenAI Responses API with service_tier=default and store=false.
Provider-reported input/output token usage is authoritative.
The provider model identifier returned by every response must match the frozen model identifier.
If a dated snapshot identifier becomes available before the first paid run, create a new config version rather than silently changing this freeze.
